fit_intro: Matched line by line to the AI Marketing Specialist role.
fit: ScoopBot and Autologist research, write, design and publish for live Instagram brands every day.
The launch tracker files every brochure and price list on its own, and the newsroom drafts posts four times a day without me.
English and Egyptian-Arabic copy, AI images with a vision check, and a humanizer that is not allowed to change numbers.
I turn GA4 and Looker Studio data into creative briefs and optimization recommendations.
Production prompts with few-shot examples, rule memory and fact-check chains across five AI providers.
Event pipelines on cron, webhooks, Telegram, WhatsApp and the Instagram API, written to run around the clock.
The daily intelligence digest, the trend scout and Ta2keed are Python.
why: I came to marketing the long way round. I studied civil engineering, supervised roadworks at a naval base, then spent three years selling property in New Cairo before I wrote my first SEO article.

That path is why I build the way I do. Sales taught me what a qualified lead really is. Writing 190 articles taught me what a search engine rewards. Leading creative on a large Meta budget taught me that the brief matters more than the tool.
AI is where those meet. My agents do the reading, drafting and checking that used to fill a marketer's day, and people keep the judgement. Nothing goes out without someone saying ok.
